title: D4 herald-aware critical-band refinement
question: Can denser sampling inside the unresolved p_X=0.20--0.22 band localize pairwise finite-size crossings for herald-weight MWPM and signal-only fixed-final-iterate BeliefMatching?

source_boundary.fixed_channel: paper-normalized periodic D4 red-X channel with p_Z=0
source_boundary.fixed_public_record: binary signal-only e_B/e_G record; zero does not reveal measurement support
source_boundary.fixed_score: paper-unconditional first-stage Boolean-union flux logical error

scan_design.stage_2_selection_rule: For each decoder, retain new cells at or immediately adjacent to a p interval whose adjacent-size difference has a 90% interval containing zero or whose point estimates change sign; take the union across L=7->9, 9->11, and 11->13.

inference.pairwise_crossing: piecewise-linear zero interpolation only inside a sampled sign-changing bracket, with a 90% parametric-binomial bootstrap band
inference.release_rule: Report a numerical crossing band only when the point estimate is bracketed by adjacent sampled p values and at least the two largest-size-pair bootstrap bands overlap; otherwise report unresolved and show the signed-difference panel.
inference.no_fit_rule: No thermodynamic finite-size-scaling fit, universal exponent, or full two-stage threshold claim is authorized.

resource_budget.storage_change: store deterministic seeds, terminal status, two logical-loss bits, and BP iteration diagnostics; do not duplicate physical edge sets or correction chains

acceptance_items.item: visible Figure L004.8 source-chain audit and readable baseline redraw
compact fail-closed runner and deterministic replay smoke
24-cell Stage-1 refinement and frozen adaptive selection
authorized Stage-2 increments through the registered cap
combined analysis, regenerated Figure L004.8, rendered-page verification, and durable synthesis

claim_boundary: This refines first-stage finite-size crossing diagnostics for two fixed public-record decoders. It is not the complete two-stage D4 threshold, and BeliefMatching remains a fixed-final-iterate algorithm because the registered BP runs do not converge within 40 iterations.

supersession.reason: The durable R6AH next-transition contract forbids restarting R6AE or fitting/refining a crossing and requires the corrected R6AF complete-public-interface transfer replacement instead.
supersession.excluded_work: A pre-transition runner smoke produced exactly one trajectory in each of 24 cells. These 24 histories and their 24 replay records are aborted provenance only: they are not analyzed, bootstrapped, pooled, plotted, or usable for any scientific claim.
